items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I had met Billy Eckstine in Pittsburgh once when we played a dance there.

ctx.x: He played alto and he sang. He sang very good. In fact, he -- he -- he was the principal singer in Earl's band at one time, before Earl got, like, Billy Eckstine and Arthur D. Simpkins, and those guys. But, anyway, you know, it's a (inaudible) a good musicians.
